+def handle_list_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw_page = params.get("page", "1")
+    raw_page_size = params.get("page_size", "10")
+
+    if not isinstance(raw_page, str) or not raw_page.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid pagination"}
+    if not isinstance(raw_page_size, str) or not raw_page_size.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid pagination"}
